text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} bumps into Ruka after
finishing up a particularly late shift.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その日夜遅くまでバイトに出ていた{0}は、
帰り道でルカと出会った──

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Hey there.
Where are you off to this late at night?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、お前さん。
こんな遅くにどこへ行こうってんだい？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're on your way home? Then don't let me hold you up.
I assume you've heard about the slasher that's been
stirring up trouble recently, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ帰るところか。
なら早く行きな。
最近ランドソルに通り魔が出る話、
聞いてるだろ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
That's got pretty much everyone scared stuff.
Only people I've seen out at night these past few days
are people confident in their skills and royal knights.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなソイツを怖がっちまってね。
ここ数日で夜に見かけるのは、
腕に自信のあるヤツか騎士団くらいだよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
The stores around here are still open,
but you sure won't find any customers in them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この辺りの店も明かりは点いちゃいるが、
客入りはさっぱりだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
What about me, then?
You know the answer to that already, don't you?
I've been asked to help deal with our little slasher friend.
choice_data_list: That's one way to get me worried...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
アタシかい？　
お前さんならもう分かるだろ。
みんなから通り魔退治を頼まれたのさ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the concern,
but this is too dangerous for you. You'll be safe if you stay home,
so get going already.
choice_data_list: There's no place safer than by your side.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ちは嬉しいけど、
今回はさすがに危ないよ。
安全に過ごせるとこがあるなら、
急いで帰りな。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
By my side, huh? Haha! Fair enough!
Fine, fine. You got me good.
Just make sure you stick by me, no matter wha—
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん……
ははっ！　
確かにそうか！　
コイツは一本取られたね。
分かったよ。
ただし、絶対にアタシから離れるんじゃないよ──

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──うわああああああっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That was quick! Let's get going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早速お出ましか！　
行くよ、お前さん！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hey! You okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいアンタ、
大丈夫か！？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うーん……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness. He's still breathing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
良かった。
息はあるみたいだね。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Y-you're...
text_block_list.orig_text: ア、アンタは……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: What happened here?
text_block_list.orig_text: 何があった？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
We... we wanted to get rid of that slasher.
But we didn't stand a chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレらは、
通り魔を、倒そうと思って……
でも、
まるで歯が立たなかった……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Did you manage to catch a glimpse of what they looked like?
text_block_list.orig_text:
顔は？　
見てないのか？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
They...? Th-that thing wasn't human!
Are you gonna go after it? Be careful if you do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
顔……
ア、
アレは、
人間なんかじゃなかった……！
追いかけるなら、
アンタらも気をつけろ……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Same to you. You should get going if you can move.
Or do you need me to call for help first?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタもね。
動けるなら早いとこ逃げな。
それとも助けを呼んでこようか？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
No, I can move. But wait... My partner's gone!
He was right here a minute ago. Did you guys see him?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
動けるからいい……
待ってくれ。
相棒がいない……！
仲間もここにいたんだ。
アンタら、見てないか！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Afraid not. He must have run off to get help.
I'll fill him in if I see him though. Stay safe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや？　
どっかへ助けを呼びに行ったんだろうさ。
見かけたらアンタのことは伝えとくよ。
じゃあね！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
He said it wasn't human. Does that mean a monster
got into town? Either way, we need to track it down
before there are any more victims!
text_block_list.orig_text:
人間じゃないって、
まさか魔物が街に入りこんでるのか……？
とにかく、
次の被害者が出る前に、
通り魔を見つけないとね！

text_block_list.name: Knight 1
text_block_list.text: Haaah!
text_block_list.orig_text: はあっ！

text_block_list.name: Youth
text_block_list.text: Gragh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ぐあっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: What's going on over there?
text_block_list.orig_text: あれは……？

text_block_list.name: Knight 2
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Finally settled down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふぅ。
やっと大人しくなったか。

text_block_list.name: Knight 3
text_block_list.text:
That took me by surprise.
Never expected him to go wild out of nowhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきは冷や汗かいたぜ。
いきなり暴れだしやがって……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Guess our help wasn't needed.
Hey, what's his deal?
Is he the slasher everyone's been talking about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
加勢はいらなかったか。
騎士さんよ、
ソイツは何者だい？　
噂の通り魔か？

text_block_list.name: Knight 1
text_block_list.text:
We're not sure. He just attacked us out of nowhere.
Either way, we're going to restrain him and take him away.
We'll need his weapon, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分からん。
急に襲いかかってきてな。
どちらにせよひとまず拘束し、連行する。
得物も回収しないとな……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
A katana, huh? That's rare to see around here.
Well, that settles that.
Let's leave the rest to the knights and get going.
text_block_list.orig_text:
刀か。
この辺じゃ珍しいな……
やれやれ、一件落着か。
お前さん、
後は騎士団にまかせて、
アタシたちは帰るとしよう。

text_block_list.name: Knight 1
text_block_list.text: GUAAAARGH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐあああああっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?!
text_block_list.orig_text: どうした！？

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
Grrrrrr...! More! I need more!
What a fantastic vessel, though!
Much better than the previous one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐうううううううっ……！
　
まだだ、
まだ足りぬ……！
しかしこの体、
先程のものよりは使えそうだな……！

text_block_list.name: Knight 2
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what in the world?!
What's happening?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだ……！？　
一体、何が……！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: A monster?! No, that's no regular monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物！？　
いや、違う……！？

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
Mwahahaha! The time has come for my full strength to be unleashed!
Woman. I sense incredible power within you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くかかかかっ……！　
ようやくワシが顕現出来るぞ……！
そこな女。
かなりの使い手と見た……！

text_block_list.name: Knight 3
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?! Snap out of it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたんだ！　
しっかりしろ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Now I get it. It's that katana!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか、
あの刀か……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
There's a certain story I heard back home when I was still a kid.
About bewitched blades that hold their own will.
That katana has to be one of them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ガキの頃、故郷で聞かされた話があってね……
物でありながら、意思を持つ妖刀……
あの刀も、その類に違いない！

text_block_list.name: Knight 2
text_block_list.text: Hey! What's going on here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
なにがあった！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! Your comrade's been possessed by that katana!
And he'll stay that way, so long as the blade's in his hand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいか！　
アンタたちのお仲間は、
あの刀に取り憑かれちまった！
刀を手から叩き落とさないと、
お仲間は操られたままだ！

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha!
Rejoice, humans. For your lives end here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くかか！　
喜べ……
おぬしら全員、
ここで斬り捨てようぞ！

text_block_list.name: Knight 2
text_block_list.text: Graaagh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐああっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
It's going to overwhelm them!
Quick, let's help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツ、強い……！　
お前さん、
助太刀するよ！

text_block_list.name: Knight 3
text_block_list.text:
No! You should run!
A knight should never put a citizen in harm's way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、キミたちは逃げろ！
守るべき民を、危険に晒すわけにはいかない！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Quit fronting! You've got no chance of beating that thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
バカ言ってんじゃないよ！　
アンタたちじゃ勝てっこない！！

text_block_list.name: Knight 2
text_block_list.text:
Even still! We're proud knights of our country!
Fleeing isn't an option!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが……我々は騎士だ！　
逃げるわけにはいかん！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Forget your ridiculous pride!
Is that really worth dying over?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
下らない意地張ってんじゃないよ！　
メンツのために死ぬ気か！？

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
Right she is!
You know not your own limits!
And for that, you must perish!
text_block_list.orig_text:
女の言う通りよ……！　
己が力量すら分からぬ愚図どもめ……！
今ここで死ね……！

text_block_list.name: Knight 3
text_block_list.text: A-aaaaahhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: う、うわああああっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Back me up!
Not a single person is going to die tonight.
Not so long as I'm here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん！　
力を貸しておくれ！
アタシの目の前では、
誰一人死なせやしないっ──！

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
Ungh! Mwahaha!
You're as impressive as I thought, woman!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬうっ！　
くかかかかっ！　
女！　
やはり出来るな！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Can't say I care about your compliments!
Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソイツぁどうも！　
はあっ！！

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
Ungh! Hah hah hah!
Quite the close call, that was!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬおっ！　
はっはっはっ！　
危なかったわ！

text_block_list.name: Knight 2
text_block_list.text: Amazing! She's on equal footing with it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい……！　
互角に渡り合ってる……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Don't just stand there! Hurry up and go get help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何やってんだ！　
ぼさっとしないで早く助けを呼びに行きな！

text_block_list.name: Knight 3
text_block_list.text: G-got it!
text_block_list.orig_text: は、はいっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Equal footing? Not good enough. But that thing's using its host as a shield. 
My only options are to knock the blade out of his hand, or just cut
him down. Either way, we're at a stalemate as things stand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
互角なもんか。
コイツめ、
乗っ取った肉体を盾にしてやがる……
刀を手から弾き飛ばすか叩き折るかしたいけど、
これじゃ埒が明かないよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You just had to go and make things difficult, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
化け物風情が、
セコい真似してくれるじゃないか！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
We can throw it off guard like that, huh?
Good call!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それならヤツの気も逸れるか。
さすがだね、お前さん！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You want to flank it, right?
Roger that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
挟み撃ちだね？　
了解だっ！

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
A pincer attack, is it?
Don't waste your time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
挟撃か、
つまらん真似を！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Now's your chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん、
今だっ！

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You fool!
Such a feeble strike will never do away with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん！　
この程度の力で
ワシに歯向かうとは愚かな！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You're wide open, my friend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
隙あり！　
もらったっ！

text_block_list.name: Knight 1 (Katana)
text_block_list.text: Impossible! Graaagh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとぉ！　
ぐうぅっ……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Perfect! I knocked it clean out of his hands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
刀は弾き飛ばせたよ！

text_block_list.name: Katana
text_block_list.text: Curses! I require a new host!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おのれぇ……！　
早く新たな持ち主を探さねば……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
It can move on its own?! Watch out! It'll get away!
Don't let it slip by you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
刀だけで動いた！？　
まずい、逃げられる！
お前さん、
ソイツを逃がすんじゃないよ！

text_block_list.name: Katana
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You dare to touch me, do you?
Very well. Then your body shall be mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬぅ？　
貴様、
ワシを手にしたな？
良かろう、
ならば望みどおりにしてやろう！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
What're you doing?!
Let go of it! Quick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何してるんだいお前さん！　
ソイツを放すんだ！　早く！

text_block_list.name: Katana
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Quite the frail vessel, but alas.
All I need to do is flee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
先ほどよりは貧弱だがまあいい！
この場は逃げるが勝ちよ……！

text_block_list.name: Katana
text_block_list.text:
...What is the meaning of this? I can't move!
Is he rejecting my influence?! Impossible!
How can one so frail possess such a strong will?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
何故だ、
体が動かぬ！　
こやつめ、ワシに抗うというのか！？
バカな！　
こんな体の何処に、
ここまでの意志が……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Did you manage to stop it from moving?!
choice_data_list: Cut through the both of us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさかお前さん、
ソイツの動きを封じてるのか！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Was that your plan all along?!
Okay, leave it to me. I'll do just that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん……
最初からそのつもりで……！
……まかせときな。
キレイさっぱり叩き斬ってやるよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
My greatest technique will be your final reckoning.
Origin Strike: Severing Moon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシの妙技、
とくと味わいな！　妖刀野郎！
秘剣、
零の太刀！　
水月鏡花！

text_block_list.name: Katana
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. To think one could cut clean through my spirit.
Very well. I can think of no one more ideal than you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
見事なり。
よもやワシの妖気のみを斬り払うとは……
良いぞ良いぞ……
これほどの使い手ならば……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you okay? Tell me you're okay.
Thank goodness... I haven't used that technique in a while,
so I'm glad it went well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん、
無事か？　
無事なんだね？
良かったぁ……
久しぶりに使う技だったけど、
上手くいってよかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I'd actually planned on using it when we went on that ghost hunt.
But anyway, the sword should be fine to hold it now
that I've weakened it this much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は今の、
幽霊退治の時に使おうと思ってた技なんだ。
さあて、
今のでコイツは弱らせたし、
もう持っても大丈夫だね。

text_block_list.name: Katana
text_block_list.text:
H-heh... I can feel it. My spirit is fading.
Tell me. What is your name?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
ふふ……
消える。
ワシの思念が消えていく……
女よ、名は何と言う？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm Ruka.
What's your deal? Trying to score yourself a parting gift?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ？　
ルカだ。
なんだいいきなり
冥土の土産にでもするつもりかい？

text_block_list.name: Katana
text_block_list.text:
My name is Haromaru.
You have proven yourself more than worthy of wielding me.
Finally... Finally, I can return to being a simple blade.
text_block_list.orig_text:
我が名は
『波浪丸』
……おぬしこそ、
ワシに相応しい使い手なり……
ああ、
これでようやく、
ただの刀に戻れる……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. [i]That's[/i] why you stirred up all this trouble?
You sure are blunt for a katana, aren't you?
But oh well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ。
そのためにあんな真似してたってのか？
愚直にも加減ってもんがあるだろ……
でもま、
しょうがないか。
刀だしね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
As for you, mister. You know what's coming.
You big, dumb idiot! What was even going through your head?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さてと
お前さん。
アタシが今一番言いたいこと、分かるかい？
このバカっ！
　
なんて真似しやがるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare pull something like that again, you hear?
You're the last person I ever want to cross blades with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
無茶するんじゃないよ、
まったく……！
お前さんと戦うなんて、
アタシはゴメンだからね……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Worry? You almost gave me a heart attack!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホントだよ！　
心臓が止まるかと思ったじゃないか！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: It better not. Promise me, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならいいけどさ……
もうあんな真似はするんじゃないよ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
It's weird, though. I don't think I've ever felt this relieved before.
Is this how you feel whenever I'm up against danger?
text_block_list.orig_text:
変だね……
自分でもビックリするくらい、ホッとしてる。
お前さんもアタシに付き合ってる時は、
いつもこんな気持ちなのか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Now I know what it's like to be in your shoes after that little stunt.
So I'll tone it down myself. Fair's fair, right?
